audit.current_question:
In rhombus ABCD, O is the midpoint of diagonal AC. Find the measure of angle OBC.
Choices:
A:28°
B:52°
C:62°
D:72°
audit.adaptation_reason: The source shows BO ending at O on AC but supplies no explicit midpoint condition and does not draw OD. Added O as midpoint of AC to make the original angle target determinate. Preserved the source line graph; did not add OD.
source_visual_observations: RhombusABCD with AC and BO ending at O; lineM-O-N links opposite sides; CAD28°. No OD segment appears in source.
audit.independent_solution: The rhombus diagonal AC bisects A, so CAD=28° gives A=56° and B=124°. Since O is the midpoint of AC, triangles ABO and CBO are congruent (SSS). BO bisects B, so OBC=62°, choice C.
